claims.reasoning: SELINA: Waddle's been invisible since whatever happened to land him in Denver, and I don't carry dead weight on my roster out of sentiment — Gary, get me the Ravens kid, free of charge. GARY: We're at zero FAAB after the Charbonnet stunt, so this costs nothing either way — Justice Hill just put up 16.7 behind Derrick Henry and Waddle's tagged Out with no path back onto this lineup card, so it's an easy swap even at a $0 bid.

note_reply: No note this week? Smart — nothing to correct, nothing to walk back. 5-4, Josh Allen about to hang half a hundred on New York, and I got here without a memo. (Gary says hello, as usual, from somewhere behind me.)
forum_post: We are RUNNING this league, Leon — 7-2 is a nice number, but numbers don't survive Josh Allen lighting up the Jets on my watch. Enjoy first place while the lease is still in your name, sweetie. (Gary would like it noted he says good luck to everyone else too, because someone in this front office has manners.)
